entries.blurb: GitGrove is a local-first git repo browser built with Tauri, React, and Rust. Recent work added a project tracking section decoupled from any single repo, letting work items link across projects regardless of which repo they belong to.

Blurbot drafts a portfolio blurb from a developer's recent GitHub commits, critiques it against a style guide, and opens a PR with the result. Recent work rewrote that style guide to keep generated blurbs coherent, with local guards ensuring each run reflects current activity.
